words.definition: n. 重复，反复；重演

examples.en: Learning requires repetition over time.
examples.zh: 学习需要反复练习。

examples.en: The repetition of the same mistakes is frustrating.
examples.zh: 同样的错误一再重演，令人沮丧。

words.usage: avoid/require repetition（避免/需要重复）；repetitive adj. 重复乏味的（repetitive strain injury 劳损）；repeat v. 同根；重音在 -ti-。
collocations: repetition of mistakes 重蹈覆辙

words.definition: n. 虚荣（心）；自负；梳妆台

examples.en: Her vanity was hurt by the criticism.
examples.zh: 批评刺痛了她的虚荣心。

examples.en: He sat at the vanity, combing his hair.
examples.zh: 他坐在梳妆台前梳头。

words.usage: vanity fair（名利场，文学）、vanity plate（个性车牌）高频；vain（自负的）同根；vanity project（面子工程）贬义。
collocations: wounded vanity 受伤的虚荣心

words.definition: prep./adv. 在…下面；在底下

examples.en: The letter was hidden underneath a pile of magazines.
examples.zh: 信藏在一摞杂志底下。

examples.en: She wore a thermal top underneath.
examples.zh: 她在里面穿了件保暖衣。

words.usage: underneath 与 under（介词）、below（方位）辨析：underneath 更强调「贴着底下/内里」；beneath（诗性）同义。
collocations: underneath the surface 表面之下

words.definition: n. 经济衰退，不景气；后退

examples.en: The economy slid into recession last year.
examples.zh: 去年经济滑入衰退。

examples.en: House prices fell sharply during the recession.
examples.zh: 经济衰退期间房价大跌。

words.usage: in/into recession（处于/陷入衰退）财经高频；economic/global recession；recede v. 后退；re（回）+ cede（走）→ 退走。
words.mnemonic: re(回)+cession(走)→ 退潮 → 衰退

words.definition: v. 使熟悉，使了解

examples.en: Please acquaint me with the facts of the case.
examples.zh: 请让我了解案件实情。

examples.en: New staff should acquaint themselves with safety rules.
examples.zh: 新员工应熟悉安全规程。

words.usage: acquaint sb/oneself with（使…熟悉）固定结构；acquaintance n. 熟人；be well acquainted with（对…了如指掌）；quaint（古雅）同源词形。
collocations: acquaint sb with 使某人了解

words.definition: n. 叛乱，反抗；叛逆（青春期）

examples.en: The rebellion was crushed by the army.
examples.zh: 叛乱被军队镇压。

examples.en: Teenage rebellion is a normal phase.
examples.zh: 青春期叛逆是正常阶段。

words.usage: put down/crush a rebellion（平定叛乱）高频；rise in rebellion（揭竿而起）；rebel v./n. 叛逆者；rebellious adj.；bell（战）词根同 belligerent。
collocations: crush a rebellion 镇压叛乱
rise in rebellion 揭竿而起
words.mnemonic: re(反)+bell(战)→ 反战旗 → 叛乱

words.definition: n. 锯子 v. 锯开；（see 的过去式）看见；谚语

examples.en: He cut the plank with a hand saw.
examples.zh: 他用手工锯锯开木板。

examples.en: The old saw says practice makes perfect.
examples.zh: 老话说得好，熟能生巧。

words.usage: saw（锯）三态 saw-sawed-sawn；a chain saw（链锯）；an old saw（老生谚语）文学义；see 的过去式 saw 同拼，语境区分。

words.definition: n. 目录，（商品）图册 v. 编目录；记录

examples.en: The library catalogues rare books by century.
examples.zh: 图书馆按世纪为古籍编目。

examples.en: A catalogue of errors doomed the project.
examples.zh: 一连串失误断送了该项目。

words.usage: mail-order catalogue（邮购目录）；a catalogue of（一连串，多指坏事）习语高频；catalog（美式拼写）；cata（下）+ logue（说）→ 逐条列出。
collocations: a catalogue of errors 一连串失误

words.definition: n. 香肠，腊肠

examples.en: We grilled sausages at the barbecue.
examples.zh: 我们在烧烤架上烤香肠。

examples.en: English breakfast usually includes sausages and beans.
examples.zh: 英式早餐通常有香肠和豆子。

words.usage: sausage meat（香肠肉馅）；banger（香肠，英俚）；复数 sausages；词源拉丁 sal（盐腌）。
words.mnemonic: sau（盐）+sage 腌出来 → 香肠

words.definition: n. 讽刺（作品），讥讽

examples.en: The show is a biting satire on politics.
examples.zh: 这档节目是对政治的辛辣讽刺。

examples.en: Satire was his favourite weapon as a writer.
examples.zh: 讽刺是他作为作家的首选武器。

words.usage: a satire on/against（对…的讽刺）高频；satirical adj. 讽刺的；satirize v. 讽刺；satur（饱）→ 塞满辛辣话。
collocations: a satire on 对…的讽刺

words.definition: n. （大学）学院院长，系主任；教长

examples.en: The dean welcomed the new students.
examples.zh: 院长迎接了新生。

examples.en: She was appointed dean of the medical faculty.
examples.z�: 她被任命为医学院院长。

words.usage: the Dean of the Faculty of Law（法学院院长）高频；dean's list（优秀生名单，美式）；deanery 院长职务；词源 decanus（十人之长）。
collocations: dean of the faculty 学院院长

words.definition: n. 伤疤，伤痕；（心灵）创伤 v. 留下伤痕

examples.en: The operation left only a small scar.
examples.zh: 手术只留下一条小疤痕。

examples.en: The war scarred him for life.
examples.zh: 战争给他留下了一生的创伤。

words.usage: leave a scar（留下疤痕）；emotional scar（心灵创伤）比喻高频；scarred adj.（scarred for life 终生留痕）；scarf（围巾）加 f 形近。
collocations: scarred for life 终生留痕

words.definition: n. 素食者 adj. 素食的

examples.en: As a vegetarian, she avoids all meat and fish.
examples.zh: 作为素食者，她不吃任何肉和鱼。

examples.en: The restaurant offers a vegetarian menu.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅提供素食菜单。

words.usage: vegetarian diet（素食）高频；vegan（纯素，不吃蛋奶）严格版；vegetable（蔬菜）词基 veget（活；植物）；flexitarian 弹性素食新词。

words.definition: n. 幻想，想象；幻想作品；幻想曲

examples.en: He lives in a world of fantasy.
examples.zh: 他活在一个幻想世界里。

examples.en: Fantasy novels often feature dragons and wizards.
examples.zh: 奇幻小说常有龙和巫师。

words.usage: live in a fantasy world（活在幻想中）高频；fantasy football（梦幻联赛）；fantasize v. 幻想（fantasize about）；复数 fantasies。

words.definition: n. 反叛者，叛逆者 v.（动读 -el）反叛，反抗

examples.en: The rebels seized the radio station.
examples.zh: 叛军占领了电台。

examples.en: Teenagers often rebel against their parents.
examples.zh: 青少年常与父母对着干。

words.usage: rebel against（反抗…）固定搭配；rebellion n. 叛乱；rebellious adj.；名读 ˈrebl，动读 rɪˈbel；拉丁 bellum（战争）。
words.mnemonic: re(反)+bel(战)→ 反战者 → 叛逆

words.definition: n. 茶碟，碟子

examples.en: She placed the cup on its saucer.
examples.zh: 她把茶杯放在茶碟上。

examples.en: The children claimed to have seen a flying saucer.
examples.zh: 孩子们声称看到了飞碟。

words.usage: flying saucer（飞碟）高频；a cup and saucer（一套杯碟）；sauce（酱）词源同（装酱小碟）；cup and saucer 成对记忆。

words.definition: adj. 有形的，实实在在的；可触摸的

examples.en: The project produced tangible results.
examples.zh: 项目取得了实实在在的成果。

examples.en: There was a tangible sense of relief in the room.
examples.zh: 房间里弥漫着显而易见的轻松感。

words.usage: tangible benefits/assets/results（切实的好处/有形资产/成果）高频；tang（触）同根 tangible（可触）；反义 intangible（无形的：intangible assets 无形资产）。
collocations: tangible benefits 实实在在的好处
words.mnemonic: tang(触)+ible → 可触摸 → 有形

words.definition: n. 磁带；胶带；带子 v. 录音；用胶带粘

examples.en: She recorded the interview on tape.
examples.zh: 她把采访录在了磁带上。

examples.en: Tape the poster to the wall.
examples.zh: 用胶带把海报粘到墙上。

words.usage: sticky tape（胶带）、tape recorder（录音机）高频；red tape（官僚繁文缛节）习语高频；tape up（缠住）；video tape 录像带。

words.definition: v. 使安心，打消疑虑

examples.en: The doctor reassured the patient about the operation.
examples.zh: 医生让病人对手术放心。

examples.en: Parents were reassured by the school's quick response.
examples.zh: 学校的迅速反应让家长安了心。

words.usage: reassure sb that/about（让某人对…放心）固定结构；reassurance n. 安抚（need reassurance）；re（再）+ assure（保证）→ 再保证。
collocations: reassure sb that 使某人确信
words.mnemonic: re(再)+assure(保)→ 再保证 → 安心

words.definition: n. 晒黑的肤色；棕褐色 v. 晒黑；鞣（革）

examples.en: She came back from the beach with a lovely tan.
examples.zh: 她从海边回来，晒出了漂亮的古铜色。

examples.en: Don't forget to apply sunscreen if you want to tan safely.
examples.zh: 想安全晒黑就别忘了涂防晒。

words.usage: get/develop a tan（晒出古铜色）高频；sun tan（日晒）；tanned adj. 晒黑的；tan sb's hide（狠揍，俚语）；鞣皮义 tan leather。
